claim: Onboarding OB-6, sign-up hand-off (founder /goal 2026-11-07, every fork the session's call; proposal p4-scratch/sw-walk/onboarding/proposal.md §3 OB-6). AuthContext.registerAccount keeps the gateway's verificationMail in sessionStorage 'mudavym:verification-mail' (noteSignUpMail; every read and write in try/catch), without editing Register.tsx (open PR #691 owns it). /verify-email reads it once (readSignUpMail), clears it (clearSignUpMail), and says 'not_sent' as an alert beside the resend button and 'unconfirmed' as 'Sending is taking longer than usual. The email may still arrive; ...'; 'sent' keeps today's words. The web VerificationMail type and resendOutcome know 'unconfirmed', and a resend answered 'unconfirmed' is a status note, never a 'sent' toast. Behavioural proof: apps/web/src/pages/__tests__/VerifyEmail.signUpMail.test.tsx, apps/web/src/contexts/AuthContext.signUpMail.test.tsx and apps/web/src/lib/verificationMail.test.ts, which fail against origin/fix/verify-mail-carries-a-code's web files.
verify: grep -qF "export type VerificationMail = 'sent' | 'not_sent' | 'unconfirmed'" apps/web/src/lib/verificationMail.ts && grep -qF "export const VERIFICATION_MAIL_KEY = 'mudavym:verification-mail'" apps/web/src/lib/verificationMail.ts && grep -qF 'noteSignUpMail(response.data?.verificationMail)' apps/web/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx && grep -qF 'useState(() => readSignUpMail())' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && grep -qF 'useEffect(() => clearSignUpMail(), [])' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && grep -qF "setMailNote(verificationMailSentence('unconfirmed'))" apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && test -f apps/web/src/pages/__tests__/VerifyEmail.signUpMail.test.tsx && test -f apps/web/src/lib/verificationMail.test.ts && test -f apps/web/src/contexts/AuthContext.signUpMail.test.tsx
